payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image read overall as a drawing made from chalk, rather than merely a generically textured or sketch-stylized image?
node.criteria: Inspect the edited image independently before comparing progress. Judge the apparent drawing medium across the subjects and setting, considering how contours, marks, shading and color collectively convey chalk. Powdery or broken marks, rubbed shading and chalk-like pigment coverage can be relevant cues, but no individual cue or particular technique is mandatory. Pass if the overall depiction convincingly has the appearance of a chalk-made drawing. Fail if it clearly does not, including a merely photographic texture overlay or a drawing-like treatment that clearly lacks a chalk-medium appearance. Grain, diagonal strokes, softness or a textured surface alone are insufficient to establish chalk, but realistic detail and recognizable contours do not themselves establish failure. Do not require a blackboard, monochrome palette, visible chalk sticks or removal of every photographic-looking detail. Unknown if the apparent medium or overall fulfillment cannot reliably be determined.
node.binding: O1: Judge the edited image against the requested outcome of a chalk drawing; supporting evidence does not independently earn completion credit.
